title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mizuki's birthday
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hehehe, I wonder if I'll surprise everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They told me not to come since they're still preparing for the party...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But a quick visit wouldn't hurt. Besides, I can't wait to show them this!)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya! How's everything going?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold up.
Why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You know the party's tonight, right?
Also, I'm pretty sure I told you not to come, because we're not done preparing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, and you did. I'll head off soon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I have something I wanted to show you before the party!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is it the thing you're holding?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh? Sharp eyes, Mafuyu!
I actually received a birthday present from overseas!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Overseas?
Oh... Is it from your sister?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ding ding ding♪ Correct♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was over the moon when this gift from Sis came! I was itching to show it to everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: W-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It doesn't seem to look that big either.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. You wanna know? You really, really wanna know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I recall your sister being a fashion designer. In that case, is your gift fashion-related?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! Nice, Luka! You figured it out in one shot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So... Ta-da!
Check it out! Isn't this so cute?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A dress?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, that is very cute. Oh, I really like this bit with the lace. It's so intricate!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. I think this would really suit you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! And these frills are just so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's EXACTLY my style and has everything I love! Sis' skills sure are above the rest.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, she made this by hand?! I thought she bought this from some high-class brand.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. She's pretty amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Something fell...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Looks like a card.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? I wonder where that came from.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think it dropped when you showed us the dress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess the card was in the dress the whole time. I totally missed that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's probably a birthday card from your sister.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, seems so. It even says “To Mizuki!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What does it say?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She hopes that I have a great birthday! That's so sweet. She thinks about me despite being miles away.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You have such a wonderful sister.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe, I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright then, now that I'm done showing off, I'll head off now. I wouldn't want to get in the way of your prep work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, wait.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was saving this until the party, but... It's not like I can't say it when you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The real celebration starts tonight, alright? Don't be late.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You got it! I have some other plans before, but I'll make sure to be there on time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Plans?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm meeting with An! Apparently, she planned something to celebrate my birthday, so I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! I'm excited to find out what she's got planned♪
